title: Add RecipeDiscovery folder scanner
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeDiscovery.swift. Synchronous (or async) scanner that accepts a security-scoped folder URL and returns [FolderSection]. Scans one level deep: top-level .cook files → section named (no folder); each immediate subdirectory → named section with its own top-level .cook files. Skips hidden entries (names starting with .). Only includes .cook files (case-insensitive). Sections sorted alphabetically; (no folder) sorts last. Rows within each section sorted alphabetically case-insensitively.
acceptance_criteria: Returns [FolderSection] for a given folder URL.
Top-level .cook files are grouped under (no folder).
Each immediate subdirectory yields a named section.
Hidden files and dotfolders are skipped.
Sections are sorted alphabetically; (no folder) sorts last.
Rows within each section are sorted alphabetically (case-insensitive).
No recursion beyond one subdirectory level.
